name: @agenetes/agenetes
description: The mounted Agenetes instance (L2 control-plane core): the I9.5 driver-factory-dictionary builder, the I9.3 runtime surface (create/get/close over live AgentHandles) and the I9.4 query surface (durable thread records via a pluggable ThreadStore port). Host-agnostic — depends only on @agenetes/protocol + @agenetes/runtime.
